features:
Features

Juicy Liquid Center

Each piece has a soft, chewy shell with a flavorful, juicy center that “gushes” when you bite into it.

Includes Multiple Flavors

Commonly includes Strawberry Splash and Tropical—great for variety in snacking.

Individually Wrapped Pouches

Easy to pack, carry, or portion out. Ideal for lunchboxes, after-school snacks, or road trips.

Gluten-Free

Safe for those with gluten sensitivities or allergies.

No Artificial Flavors

Made with naturally flavored ingredients—no artificial taste.

Good Source of Vitamin C

Each serving contains added Vitamin C to help support the immune system.

Low-Calorie Snack

Each pouch contains about 80–90 calories, making it a light treat.

Kosher Certified

Suitable for kosher diets.

 Benefits

Fun & Tasty for All Ages

The juicy, surprise-filled bite is especially enjoyable for kids (and nostalgic adults).

Portable Convenience

Pre-portioned pouches are perfect for school, work, or busy days.

Satisfies Sweet Cravings

A great alternative to candy with fewer calories and added vitamin C.

Better-for-You Option

Compared to traditional sweets, they’re gluten-free and contain no artificial flavors.

Kid-Friendly Favorite

Loved for its texture, bold fruity flavor, and playful “gush” in every bite.
